description: Shared types for districting plans. Deliberately flat and integer-only: every quantity a requirement can talk about must survive a canonical, total decode into a Lean value, so there are no floats, no geometry, and no free-form strings in the numeric path.

precinct.description: One indivisible unit of geography, with the population and vote tallies attributed to it.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the plan.

county.description: Containing county. Used only by the county-splits clause.

population.description: Census population. See censusSource on the plan record: nothing in this system verifies that this number is true.

votesA.description: Votes cast for party A in the reference election.

votesB.description: Votes cast for party B in the reference election.

edge.description: An undirected geographic adjacency between two precincts. Contiguity is defined against this graph and nothing else; the graph itself is an input the plan's author supplies.

assignment.description: Assignment of one precinct to one district. Exactly one entry per precinct is required for the plan to decode.
